name: Ribeiras do Morrazo

known.via: English Wikipedia "Ribeiras do Morrazo" (a wine place on Wikidata)

terms: Spain's regional wine tier, below DO.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A Galician vino de la tierra covering eight municipalities in Pontevedra province, including Cangas and Marín.
